# NP Final Scores ------------------------------

```{r Load in Sub-Scores}
# Salt production (SALT)
SALT_SubScores<- read.csv()
SALT_SubScores0<- SALT_SubScores

# Fish oil fish meal (FOFM)
FOFM_SubScores<- read.csv()
FOFM_SubScores0<- FOFM_SubScores

# Aquarium trade (AQRM)
AQRM_SubScores<- read.csv()
AQRM_SubScores0<- AQRM_SubScores

# Sea shells (SHEL)
SHEL_SubScores<- read.csv()
SHEL_SubScores0<- SHEL_SubScores

# Shark fins (FINS)
FINS_SubScores<- read.csv()
FINS_SubScores0<- FINS_SubScores

# Other residues (RESD)
RESD_SubScores<- read.csv()
RESD_SubScores0<- RESD_SubScores
```

```{r Load clean_names_lowercase function}
clean_names_lowercase <- function(x) {
  x <- iconv(x, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  x <- stringi::stri_trans_general(x, "Latin-ASCII")
  x %>%
    tolower() %>%
    trimws()
}
```

# Merge ---

```{r Prep dataframes for merging}
# Salt production (SALT)
colnames(SALT_SubScores0)
SALT_SubScores_simple<- SALT_SubScores0 %>%
  select(year, OHI_region, SALT_SubScore= region_SAL_score_capped)

SALT_SubScores_simple<- SALT_SubScores_simple %>%
  mutate(
    OHI_region = clean_names_lowercase(OHI_region)
  )

# Aquarium trade (AQRM)
colnames(AQRM_SubScores0)
AQRM_SubScores_simple<- AQRM_SubScores0 %>%
  select(year, OHI_region= OHI_region_est, AQRM_SubScore)

# Sea shells (SHEL)
colnames(SHEL_SubScores0)
SHEL_SubScores_simple<- SHEL_SubScores0 %>%
  select(year, OHI_region= OHI_region_est, SHEL_SubScore)

# Shark fins (FINS)
colnames(FINS_SubScores0)
FINS_SubScores_simple<- FINS_SubScores0 %>%
  select(year, OHI_region= OHI_region_est, FINS_SubScore)

# Other residues (RESD)
colnames(RESD_SubScores0)
RESD_SubScores_simple<- RESD_SubScores0 %>%
  select(year, OHI_region= OHI_region_est, RESD_SubScore)
```

```{r Merge Component Scores}
NP_Scores0 <- list(
  SALT_SubScores_simple,
  AQRM_SubScores_simple,
  SHEL_SubScores_simple,
  FINS_SubScores_simple,
  RESD_SubScores_simple
) %>%
  reduce(full_join, by = c("year", "OHI_region"))

NP_Scores<- NP_Scores0 %>%
  filter(!is.na(OHI_region)) %>%
  filter(year <= 2024)
```

```{r Calculate NP_Scores}
colnames(NP_Scores)

NP_Scores <- NP_Scores %>%
  mutate(
    NP_Score = rowMeans(
      select(., SALT_SubScore, AQRM_SubScore, SHEL_SubScore,
             FINS_SubScore, RESD_SubScore),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    NP_Score_n_components = rowSums(
      !is.na(select(., SALT_SubScore, AQRM_SubScore, SHEL_SubScore,
                    FINS_SubScore, RESD_SubScore))
    )
  )
```

```{r SAVE NP regional scores}
write.csv(
  NP_Scores,
  file= "/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/NP/v2025/NP_Scores/NP_Scores_DRAFT2_df_Jun302026.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# Plot final NP_Scores
```{r Plot NP_Scores over time by region}
region_colors <- c(
  "region_1" = "royalblue",
  "region_2" = "skyblue",
  "region_3" = "orange",
  "region_4" = "sienna1",
  "region_5" = "plum",
  "region_6" = "purple4",
  "region_7" = "aquamarine3",
  "region_8" = "gold2",
  "region_9" = "tomato"
)

NP_Regional_Scores_overTime <- NP_Scores %>%
  filter(!is.na(NP_Score)) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = NP_Score, color = OHI_region)) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ OHI_region, scales = "fixed") +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = region_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "GOC Natural Products: Regional NP_Score",
    subtitle = "Equal mean of of SALT, FOFM, AQRM, SHEL FINS, and RESD component scores",
    y = "NP Score (0 to 100)",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  
  ylim(0, 101) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  
  theme(legend.position = "none", 
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

NP_Regional_Scores_overTime
```
